citations.quote: Ich wende mich an Sie wegen einer geplanten Mietzinserhöhung für meine 2-Zimmer-Wohnung an der Kirchgasse 20 in Frauenfeld.
Die Vermieterin begründet die Erhöhung zum einen mit der Erhöhung des hypothekarischen Referenzzinssatzes.
Zum andern verweist sie auf Renovationsarbeiten beziehungsweise wertvermehrende Investitionen am Gebäude.
Bisheriger Mietzins: CHF 1400 pro Monat netto, zuzüglich Nebenkosten-Akonto.

plan.because: Needed to verify the parties, property and agreed tenancy terms.
The customer describes a planned increase, but the original notice and its amount, effective date, addressee and form contents are missing.
The recipient and delivery date are needed urgently to assess the challenge deadline.
The current agreed rent and its components are not established by the supplied prior adjustment.
The supplied copy gives a date and describes CHF 1400 as the previous rent, but does not state the new amount or calculation basis.
The reported reasons do not supply the landlord's calculation inputs.
A reference-rate reason is reported; the old and proposed bases and relevant dates are needed.
Renovation is a reported reason; the works, costs and claimed allocation to rent are needed.

questions: Have you received an official rent-increase notice? If so, when and by whom was it received? Please preserve the notice and envelope or delivery evidence urgently.
What is the current net rent and what additional charges are agreed? Can you provide the complete 2021 adjustment and its calculation?
